plugin.name: Windowed Mode
windowmode.description: Fullscreen is the game's own exclusive mode. Windowed is a window of the chosen resolution; at the desktop resolution its frame lies outside the screen. Borderless covers the monitor at the desktop resolution. Alt+Enter or Ctrl+Enter switches between Windowed and Borderless. Switching to or from Fullscreen needs a restart.
confinecursor.description: Keeps the mouse cursor inside the game window while the game has the focus and no menu is open.
pausefocus.description: Opens the pause menu when the game window loses the focus during gameplay. Off keeps the game running in the background.
resumefocus.description: Closes the pause menu again when the window gets the focus back, if it was opened by losing the focus.
width.description: Width of the window's picture in Windowed mode. The game's resolution menu and resizing the window change it.
height.description: Height of the window's picture in Windowed mode. The game's resolution menu and resizing the window change it.
maximized.description: The window was maximized when the game was closed.
position.description: A point on the monitor the window opens on, saved when the window moves. The window is centered on that monitor.
